name: maybe_Gfx_ReleaseCommandBuffers

evidence: Body checks byte +4 bit 0 and calls 0x116DA4 on three pairs; callers are Snd_StreamVoice_Update and Snd_SetBgmVolume, so the Gfx owner is unproven.

name: maybe_Os_SendIpcCmd0863Request
summary: Builds the request block via 0x117098 and sends fixed IPC command 0x0863, writing the reply to *out.
evidence: Only callee 0x11DED4 sets TLS+0x80=0x08630000 and issues svc 0x32; callers include Fs_Initialize and Svc_Ipc_FormatAndSend, so the Os prefix stays a guess.

name: maybe_Os_AssertAndGetState
summary: Asserts *object is non-zero (else 0x11ED40 with 0xE0A046DB) and returns the second word of global 0x7AEA38.
evidence: No callers; assert target 0x11ED40 has no readable body; returned global is the same context slot used by Snd driver code.

name: maybe_Gfx_BlitWorker
summary: Walks the occupancy bitmap of a surface table and re-submits live records whose flags clear 0x18 and whose first word is non-zero.
evidence: Body reads its table from unaff_r4 (damaged decompilation); callers are Input_ReadPadState and Save_AsyncReadWorker, so the Gfx owner is unproven.

name: maybe_Snd_QueryChannelInfo
signature: unsigned int maybe_Snd_QueryChannelInfo(unsigned int command, unsigned int in, unsigned int size, unsigned short* outCount)
summary: Forwards a channel query to the driver when the session is open, else writes 0 to *outCount and returns 0xC8A0A7F8.
evidence: Only caller 0x11302C (maybe_Snd_SetupChannelBuffers) calls it twice for count and size; IPC goes through 0x11EBD8 with command 0x10.

name: maybe_Snd_FlushChannels
summary: Per-frame flush of the active channel bank: reconfigures unit records, runs eight registered flush callbacks, clears the flag and sends teardown command 0x20.
evidence: Walks the same eight-hook table at 0x7E7998 as 0x11ECC0; caller is maybe_Gfx_ProcessFrame; owner of 0x7AEA00 unnamed.

name: maybe_Gfx_GetQueueStatus
summary: Reads the pending byte at +1 of the per-thread queue object selected by index from the TLS+0x5C array.
evidence: Only caller is Gfx_SwapFrameBuffers; TLS base via 0x11F720 has no readable body, so the Gfx prefix stays a guess.

name: maybe_Hid_ThumbReader
summary: Mis-seeded Thumb entry inside the HID reader; the decoded body is a single return 0x4C and is not the real function.
evidence: Body is `return 0x4C`; index claims 0x13E Thumb bytes overlapping the preceding routine; callers are unrelated container/sound code.

name: maybe_Hid_NormalizeCirclePad
signature: int maybe_Hid_NormalizeCirclePad(int axisX, int max, int axisY, int value)
summary: Normalises a circle-pad vector: applies the deadzone, computes the squared magnitude, takes an integer square root and scales both axes to 0x80, returning the radius.
evidence: Body writes two s16 outputs and returns the radius; second axis arrives in unaff_r6 and outputs go through unaff registers, so the signature is damaged decompilation.

name: maybe_Hid_SetVibration
summary: Stores a vibration pattern: keeps the larger of the two float arguments at +0xB8 and the other at +0xBC, stores the pattern at +0xC0 and zeroes the phase counter at +0xC4.
evidence: No exact caller; float args arrive in VFP registers (in_s0/in_s1); 'Vibration' inferred only from the +0xB8..+0xC4 layout.

name: maybe_Os_EnsureInitialized
summary: No dossier or readable body available, so the current uncertain name is retained.
evidence: No dossier (no readable file); nothing to confirm or correct.

name: maybe_Mem_FreeThroughCallback
summary: Releases a heap block through the registered deallocator slot at 0x7AE9FC, then tail-calls 0x11CC28; the container destructor 0x11EE0C calls it on its heap members.
evidence: Real entry is 0x11C814 (Ghidra four bytes late); 0x11EE0C disassembly shows blne 0x11c814 on its heap members; body calls the global slot then software_interrupt(0x3c).

name: maybe_Gfx_CallNoOpStub
summary: Thunk that calls 0x115E68 with argument 0; 0x115E68 is an empty NOP stub, so this invokes a no-op/default implementation.
evidence: Callee 0x115E68 disassembles to mov r0,r0; bx lr; the 802 callers are an xref artefact (branches into the range), exact-target scan finds none.

name: maybe_Os_IpcCmd0863
summary: Sends fixed IPC command 0x0863 (header 0x08630000) on the session in *handle, and on success copies the reply word at TLS+0x88 to *out and returns the status at TLS+0x84.
evidence: Header literal 0x08630000 and svc 0x32 are in the body; only exact caller is 0x117078 (request-block builder); meaning of the command unknown.

name: maybe_Os_WaitSemaphore
summary: Counted semaphore wait with owner hand-off: while the counter is negative it decrements and arbitrates through 0x11CC10, and when the count turns positive it flips the sign back and returns.
evidence: Negative-count-is-waiters convention, ldrex/strex exclusive loops and 0x11CC10 arbitration call match the CTR semaphore pattern; no exact caller names the object.

name: maybe_Snd_SendIpcBuffer
signature: int maybe_Snd_SendIpcBuffer(unsigned int* session, unsigned int value, unsigned int zero, unsigned int address, unsigned short size, unsigned short* outSize)
summary: Submits a buffer descriptor: header 0x001000C0 (command 0x10, three normal parameters), temporarily overwrites the thread's translated-descriptor words at +0x180 with size<<14|2 and the address, sends svc 0x32, restores both words and copies the reported size back.
evidence: Header literal 0x001000C0 and svc 0x32 in body; only exact caller is 0x1185E8 (channel query); buffer-descriptor semantics inferred from the +0x180 overwrite/restore.

name: maybe_Snd_FlushChannelsOnStop
summary: Stop-time variant of the DSP service flush: clears the active byte, submits the final unit configuration, runs the eight registered callbacks, clears the pending byte and sends session command 0x20.
evidence: Same flush sequence as 0x118788 (context 0x7AEA00, 0x11E9C4 call, eight-callback table 0x7E7998, closing command 0x20); 41 callers are generic OS/FS/Gfx helpers, so the Snd prefix is not confirmed.

name: maybe_Os_IpcStatusQuery
signature: int maybe_Os_IpcStatusQuery(unsigned int* session, unsigned int handle, unsigned int flags, unsigned int* out0, unsigned int* out1)
summary: Generic IPC status query: fills the TLS command block with header 0x00130042, issues svc 0x32, and on success writes TLS+0x88/+0x90 to the two out pointers (swapped relative to parameter order).
evidence: Callers are Gfx_WriteHwRegs, Gfx_QueueCommand, Gfx_TransferGpuBuffer, Gfx_SetTextureSource etc., contradicting the Snd prefix; the svc 0x32 + TLS block shape is a generic OS IPC helper, but the exact service is unknown.

name: maybe_Gfx_CmdList_ResetSlot
summary: Marks a command-list slot free: locks, resolves the slot pointer, locks again and stores -1 into the word 0x98 bytes before the returned pointer.
evidence: 0x120368 takes a pointer and invalidates +0x1C, so the -0x98 store is a back-reference into the slot header; no exact caller, and callers are unrelated subsystems (HashMap_Init, Effect_SpawnByName, ItemList_BuildRows).

name: maybe_Gfx_CreateChannelBuffers
signature: int maybe_Gfx_CreateChannelBuffers(unsigned int width, unsigned int height, char* mode)
summary: Creates a pair of buffers: rounds both dimensions up (+4 below 0x40, +5 above, minimum 8), calls the channel setup with shared block sizes, and on failure closes the service.
evidence: No branch target reaches this address (dead code); the +4/+5 rounding with 8-byte minimum is buffer-size arithmetic and the create/finish call pair, but the subsystem (Snd vs Gfx) is unproven.

name: maybe_Os_MainRamRangeFragment
